Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff
Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff

Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. Washington State, initiative proposed to make employing gays for jobs caring for children, the disabled, or senior citizens a gross misdemeanor; uses very discriminatory language to describe gays 2. Knoxville, Tennessee, church votes to allow Metropolitan Community Church to continue using its facility 3. Interview with co-coordinators of Heritage of Pride, Inc., discuss the forthcoming NYC Gay Pride March and Rally COMMERCIAL: "New York Native" with Quentin Crisp 4. Notre Dame prohibits gay/lesbian group from using radio station 5. Andy Humm on Catholic church's prohibitive stance on priests and sexuality 6. California extends equal employment protection to gays and lesbians COMMERCIAL: Urban General Warehouse sale 7. Wisconsin AIDS task force moves for contact testing 8. Travel tips for people with AIDS 9. California governor approves selective testing for HTLVIII antibody in "high-risk" patients 10. Proposed AIDS insurance bill revised to prohibit testing by insurance companies COMMERCIAL: NGTF Fund for Human Dignity 11. Sports Report 12. Outreach: Conversations with GMHC: Interview with Casey Donovan, sex-act performer, discussing safer sex and the proper use of condoms 13. Closing credits
The Right Stuff: 1. This Week in Gay History with Jeff Bixby COMMERCIAL: E-Z Trim exercise equipment 2. Clips of Lyndon LaRouche discussing AIDS and Mark Fairchild discussing AIDS patients 3. Media Watch: interview with "Mandate" magazine editor, Freeman Gunther COMMERCIAL: SF AIDS Foundation featuring Jose Sarria 4. Interview with Phil Zwickler about "Rights and Reactions," a documentary film chronicling NYC's fight to pass the gay rights bill, with clips COMMERCIAL: The Monster COMMERCIAL: SF AIDS Foundation, tape ends
